_note: ADR-037 manifest fragment for dashboards-and-who-may-see-them task 2.2 (REQ-DWMS-003). The report gallery is an ordinary index over launchpad's own endpoint (entitySource endpoint, GET /api/reports): the definitions ship with the app and are not OpenRegister objects, so there is no register to point at and no component to write. A report whose registers or schemas are missing stays in the list, says Unavailable and names them (the endpoint answers available and missing per row). Opening a row runs the report through GET /api/reports/{id}, which answers an unavailable report with available false and no result rather than an error. Save as dashboard is the endpoint's POST /api/reports/{id}/dashboard: a dashboard owned by the caller holding the result; the server refuses an unavailable report.

config.emptyText: No reports ship with this version.
